usage: The word 防水 (fong4 seoi2) is used as an adjective to describe something that prevents water from passing through.
You can use 防水 to indicate that clothing, devices, or materials have water-resistant properties.
防水 can be combined with nouns to describe items, for example, 防水袋 (waterproof bag).
When asking about whether something is waterproof, you can say 呢個防唔防水? (Is this waterproof?).
It is commonly used in everyday contexts related to weather, electronics, and outdoor equipment.
